evidence.quote: A group of 25 tech companies released a letter urging policymakers to avoid "premature restrictions" on open-weight AI models.
evidence.one_line: A group of 25 tech companies, including Nvidia, Microsoft, Meta and Palantir, released a letter on Friday urging policymakers to avoid premature restrictions on open-weight AI models.
evidence.speaker: Nvidia, Microsoft, Meta, Palantir and about 21 other companies

evidence.quote: Nvidia , Microsoft , Meta , Palantir and more than 20 other companies released a letter Friday urging policymakers to avoid "premature restrictions" on open-weight artificial intelligence models that would "stifle competition or drive innovation overseas."
evidence.one_line: Nvidia and other signatories urged policymakers to avoid restrictions on open-weight AI models in a letter released Friday.
evidence.speaker: Nvidia and other signatory companies

evidence.quote: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella both shared the letter on their personal social media accounts.
evidence.one_line: Jensen Huang shared the open-weight letter on his personal social media account.
evidence.speaker: Jensen Huang

evidence.quote: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told CNBC on Tuesday that the Trump administration would look into whether Chinese companies were stealing American intellectual property, and stated that the government has "the ability to sanction them because of this theft."
evidence.one_line: Treasury Secretary Bessent said the administration would look into Chinese IP theft and that the government could sanction Chinese companies.
evidence.speaker: Scott Bessent

evidence.quote: White House advisor Michael Kratsios on Wednesday said that China's Moonshot AI developed its Kimi K3 model by distilling Anthropic's technology.
evidence.one_line: White House advisor Kratsios said Moonshot AI developed Kimi K3 by distilling Anthropic's technology.
evidence.speaker: Michael Kratsios

evidence.quote: "Relying solely on closed models is not inherently safe: they can be breached, misused, or fail in ways that outsiders cannot detect," the letter said.
evidence.one_line: The letter argues that relying solely on closed models is not inherently safe.
evidence.speaker: Signatory letter

evidence.quote: OpenAI and Anthropic did not sign the letter.
evidence.one_line: OpenAI and Anthropic did not sign the open-weight letter.
evidence.speaker: CNBC reporting
